description: List the country, currency, and rail combinations Moneda can pay out to. Each entry includes the required fields you'll need to collect from the user before calling add_bank, add_contact_external, or initiate_payment. The output is provider-agnostic — don't branch on which underlying processor handles each rail. Pass an optional `countrySymbol` to filter (e.g. 'BR' returns only Brazilian PIX). Empty result for a country means Moneda doesn't currently support it.

countrySymbol.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 filter (e.g. 'US', 'BR', 'CO'). Use 'EU' for SEPA destinations. Omit to list everything.

name: list_supported_destinations
